s: Mimmah tzarik lihyot hassekak ubo l"g seipim: en mesakkekin ella bedabar shehu tzomeach min haaretz vehu talush min haqqarqa veeno meqabbel tuma. Abal im eno tzomeach min haaretz ap al pi sheeno meqabbel tuma, kegon orot behema shello neebdu sheenan meqabbelin tuma, o apar, o mine mattakot ap al pi shello asa mehen kelim sheenan meqabbelin tuma, veken kol dabar sherauy leqabbel tuma ap al pi shehu tzomeach min haaretz, kegon kol mine okalin ap al pi shello huksheru, vekol mine kelim apillu shel etz sheyyesh lahen bet qibbul shehen meqabbelin tuma — en mesakkekin bahen, shenneemar "chag hassukkot taaseh leka…beospeka miggorneka umiyyiqbeka", bipsolet goren vayeqeb hakkatub medabber, dehaynu qashshin o shibbolet veqanin sheosepim otan min haggoren vehayyeqeb, umehen vekayyotze bahen shetztzomechin min haaretz veeno meqabbel tuma — taaseh leka sukkot, velo middebarim acherim:

Kol dabar shehaya rauy leqabbel tuma shaa achat ap al pi sheachar kak nithar milleqabbel tuma, kegon kelim shennishberu veen beshibrehen kashshiur harauy leqabbalat tuma, veken matlaniyyot shebbalu velo nishtayyer bahen shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot sheshshub en meqabbelin tuma, veken bet yad shel keli shennishbar min hakkeli shebbeodo mechubbar lakkeli haya meqabbel tuma kamohu veakshav nithar milleqabbel shum tuma, kol ellu kevan sheppaam achat hayu reuyin leqabbalat tuma — gazeru chakamim alehem shello lesakkek bahen leolam. Veim abar vesikkek — sukkato pesula, kemo hamsakkek biskak shehu pasul min hattora:

Habbet yad shel chitztzim yesh osin otan zekarim, dehaynu sheen noqebin bahen shum neqeb ella osin bachetz keen bet qibbul vetochabin et habbet yad lesham, veyesh osin otan neqebot, dehaynu sheosin neqeb beroshan vehachetz asuy kemartzea veniknas letok hanneqeb, vehazzekarim en meqabbelin tuma, lepi sheen lahem bet qibbul, ulepikak muttar lesakkek bahen im adayin lo hayu qebuin behachetz meolam, abal hanneqebot kevan sheyyesh bahen bet qibbul, ap al pi shehabbet qibbul asuy lemalleot al yede hachetz milluy olam shello lehitroqen od — ap al pi ken hu meqabbel tuma, ulepikak im sikkek bahen — sukkato pesula:

Qanim hannibraim chalulim ap al pi sheyyesh lahen bet qibbul — en meqabbelin tuma, lepi shello naasa leqabbala, ulepikak muttar lesakkek bahem. Veken muttar lesakkek betzinnor, lepi shello naasa leqabbala:

Sikkekah bepishte haetz, shello dak otan bemakteshet velo nippetz otan bemasreq — keshera, sheadayin nikkarim shehen etz. Abal im dak otan bemakteshet, ap al pi shello nippetz otan bemasreq — pesula middibre soperim, lepi shennishtannet tzuratan ukeillu ena[n] miggiddule qarqa. Vehu haddin tzemer gepen o qannabbos shennippetz otan — en mesakkekin bahem. Veken neoret shel pishtan hanniddaq min happishtan — en mesakkekin bo:

Mesakkekin bachabalim shel gemi veshel sib, lepi shehachabalim en meqabbelin tuma, sheen lahem bet qibbul, abal chabalim shel pishtan veshel qannabbos — en mesakkekin bahen, mippene shennishtanna tzurato ukeillu eno miggiddule qarqa:

Machtzelet shel qanim veshel qash veshel gemi veshel shipa, ben shehi chalaqa sheruya lishkiba, ben sheenah chalaqa, im hi qetanna, dehaynu sheen bah ella kede shekiba — setama omedet lishkiba ureuya leqabbel tuma im yishkab aleha hazzab, ulepikak en mesakkekin bah apillu adayin lo shakab aleha hazzab, ella im ken asaah lesikkuk, o shelleqachah min haumman kede lesakkek bah, shehaumman oseh bistam lemokran lemi shetztzarik lahen kol echad veechad lepi tzorko, veim ken yesh lelek achar daat halloqeach beet qeniyyato, veim dato lesikkuk, ap al pi sheyyesh lah sapa beinyan sheruya leqabbala — ap al pi ken enah meqabbelet tuma, veqibbul zeh eno chashub kelum, kevan shehammachtzelet enah asuya leqabbala:

Abal im hi gedola yoter mikkede shekiba — setama omedet lesikkuk, vaapillu im yishkab aleha hazzab — enah meqabbelet tuma kevan sheenah meyuchedet lishkiba, velaken mesakkekin bah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen lah sapa maqqepet, abal im yesh lah sapa maqqepet (mearba ruchoteha) beinyan sheruya leqabbala — en mesakkekin bah, lepi shessetama asuya gam letashmish litten perot al gabbah (vaapillu im nittal sepatah — en mesakkekin bah, kemo sheen mesakkekim beshibre kelim kemo shennitbaer):

Vekol zeh bemaqom sheen minhag meborar betashmishe hammachtzelaot, abal bemaqom shehamminhag shel rob bene hair lehishtammesh bemachtzelaot qetannot lesikkuk — muttar lesakkek bahen apillu bistam machtzelet qetanna, ella im ken yadua shennaasim lishkiba. Ubemaqom shemminhag rob bene hair lehishtammesh bemachtzelaot gedolot lishkiba kemo shehamminhag hu bimqomot haellu — en mesakkekin bemachtzelet gedola. Vaapillu im yadua shemmachtzelet zo naaset lesikkuk — en lesakkek bah, mippene marit haayin sheen hakkol yodein bazeh veyomru shennaaset lishkiba kemo shehu minhag rob bene hair:

Veken bemaqom shennohagim liqboa machtzelaot baggaggin keen tiqra — en mesakkekin bahen, apillu naasu lesikkuk sheenan meqabbelin tuma, gezera shemma yesheb tachat tiqrat habbayit haasuya mimmachtzelaot, sheyyomar mah ben machtzelaot ellu lemachtzelaot ellu, umachtzelaot shel tiqrat habbayit pesulin min hattora, shello huqbeu sham leshem tzel ella leshem dira:

Hassullam — yesh lehistappeq bo im hu meqabbel tuma, lepi sheen bo bet qibbul vahare hu kishar kol peshute kele etz sheenan meqabbelin tuma, o epshar shehanneqabim shehashshelibot tequot bahen hen domin lebet qibbul, ulepikak en lesakkek bo. Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher shello lehannichah al gabbe haggag kede lehanniach alayv hassekak, veken shello lehannicho al gabbe hassekak kede lehachaziqo shello yepazzerennu haruach. Vehu haddin sheen mechazzeqin veen maamidin et hassekak lekattechilla bekol dabar sherauy leqabbel tuma kegon kisse vesapsal, gezera shemma yesakkek bahen:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehassikkuk beatzmo munnach al gabbe dabar shemmeqabbel tuma, o sheddabar hamqabbel tuma munnach al gabbe hassekak mammash umachaziqo, abal im hassekak munnach al gabbe kelonesaot o al gabbe yetedot vehen munnachim al gabbe dabar hamqabbel tuma — en bekak kelum, umuttar laasot ken lekattechilla, veap al pi sheddabar hammaamid umachaziq et hassekak nismak al gabbe dabar happasul lesikkuk — en bekak kelum, shehare kol sukka shebbaolam maamide hassekak hen nismakim al gabbe qarqa olam happesula lesikkuk:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar heemid et hassekak atzmo bedabar hamqabbel tuma — muttar lesheb bah lekattechilla. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar lehanniach et hassekak atzmo al gabbe haddepanot apillu im hen min happasul lesikkuk, kegon chomat abanim, lepi sheen ligzor shemma yesakkek sukkato baabanim, shehakkol yodein shehaabanim pesulin lesikkuk, shehare en zo sukka kelal ella keen bet dirat qeba. Veken muttar lekattechilla lechabber kelonesaot hassukka shehassekak munnach aleha ledopnot hassukka al yede masmerim shel barzel, o leqoshran bachatikot begadim hamqabbelin tuma, kevan shehassekak atzmo munnach al gabbe kelonesaot sheenan meqabbelin tuma ukesherim lesikkuk:

Kol peshute kele etz harechabim qetzat verauy lehanniach alehem dabar, kegon shulchan umagrepa umardeh — gazeru chakamim alehem tuma, lepi shehen domin lebet qibbul, lepikak en lesakkek bahen, veken en lehannichan al gabbe hassekak lehachaziqo, apillu im nishberu, kevan shehayu reuyim leqabbel tuma shaa achat — gazeru alehen:

Kol yedot hookalin kegon qashshin shel shibbolim uzemorot shel anabim umakbedot shel temarim — meqabbelin tuma beshaa shehen mechubbarin lehaokel, shenneemar "tame hu lakem", vedareshu chakamim "lakem" — lekol dabar shehu tzorek lakem baokel hazzeh, dehaynu yadot, hu meqabbel tuma keokel atzmo. Veeno niqra yad ella shelosha tepachim beqashshin shel min shibbolim hanniqtzarin bemaggal (abal min shibbolim sheen darkan lehiqqatzer bemaggal ella oqerin otan bayyad — en shiur lidotehen, sheapillu hen arukkin harbeh hen meqabbelim tuma mishshum yad), vearbaa tepachim bemakbedot shel temarim, ushene tepachim bizmorot shel anabim, dehaynu tepach echad mimin haeshkol hattaluy bazzemora vetepach echad missemolo. Abal im hen arukkim yoter mishshiur hazzeh — en meqabbel tuma ella mah shehu samuk lehaokel kashshiur hazzeh:

Lepikak hamsakkek sukkato beqashshin shel shibbolim, ubizmorot ubahen anabim, ubemakbedot ubahen temarim, im en haqqashshin vehazzemorot vehammakbedot arukkin kol kak ad sheyyehe bahen rob neged haokel vehayyad shello — hare hi pesula. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqatzar o batzar otan laakila, sheaz tzarik chibbur hayyad im haokel leechoz bo et haokel, abal im qetzaran ubetzaran lesikkuk, sheaz en noach lo chibbur hayyad im haokel, shehare haokel posel sukkato, velaken en hayyad meqabbel tuma, sheen hayyad meqabbel tuma ella mechamat shehu tapel umeshammesh laokel venechshab kaokel atzmo, mah sheen ken okel zeh sheen tzarik lo kelal lesikkuk shebbishbilo qetzaro veen hayyad tapel elayv, ulepikak hayyad mitztarep im shear orek haqqashshin vehazzemorot lebattel et haokel berob:

Veim mittechilla qetzaran ubetzaran laakila veachar kak nimlak alehen lesikkuk — en hammachashaba motzia et hayyadot mide qabbalat tuma, ad sheyyaaseh bahen maaseh shennikkar kesheqqatzar o batzar sherotzeh otam lesikkuk velo laakila, kegon sheyyadush otan bemaqqabot o beragle behema:
Kol shehu maakal behema veen bene adam okelin otan ella lirpua, kegon pynv"gy hanniqra bearbi shvm"r — mesakkekin bo lekattechilla:

Sikkek biraqot shemmemaharim lehityabbesh tok shiba yamim velippol healin ad sheyyishshaer avir — hare hen chashubin keillu napelu miyyad ap al pi sheadayin lo yabeshu, uposelin et hassukka apillu min hatztzad bishlosha tepachim kedin avir, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"b. Veap al pi shehen meqabbelin tuma — en dinan kiskak pasul sheeno posel ella bearbaa tepachim beemtza hassekak, dekevan shessopan libbol velippol tok hechag — en shem sekak alehen, ukeillu enan kelal:

Kol dabar hamchubbar laqqarqa — en mesakkekin bo, lepi sheeno domeh lipsolet goren vayeqeb shehem telushim min haqqarqa. Veim sikkek bimchubbar veachar kak qetzatzo — pasul, shenneemar "chag hassukkot taaseh ku'", "taaseh" — velo min heasuy bipsul, shehaasiyya harishona shehi bipsul enah chashuba asiyya kelal, keillu lo asa meuma, umah sheachar kak makshiro al yede qetzitzat hailan — en zo chashuba asiyya, kevan sheeno oseh maaseh chadash behassekak, dehaynu sheeno soterah kelal, lepikak en lo taqqana ella im ken yenanea kol hassekak happasul sheqqetzatzo, dehaynu shemmagbiho meat vechozer umannicho, shebbeshaa shemmagbiho nitbattela asiyya harishona shehayeta bipsul, veachar kak keshemmannichan hu oseh maaseh chadash begup hassukka:

Yesh debarim sheaseru chakamim lesakkek bahen lekattechilla, vehem mine asabim sherecham ra, ap al pi sheenan reuyin laakila veen meqabbelin tuma, veken mine seneh shealehen nosherin tamid ap al pi shello bishat haruach, lepi sheanu chosheshin shemma mittok sherechan ra o mittok shealehen nosherin yetze min hassukka. Veim abar vesikkek bahen — keshera, umuttar lesheb bah lekattechilla:

Chabile qash vachabile etzim — en mesakkekin bahen keshehen agudin, mippene sheppeamim sheadam ba min hassadeh baereb bekol yemot hachamma vachabilato al ketepo umannichah al gabbe sukkato sheyyesh lo kol yemot hachamma lemiqnehu kede leyabbeshah velo leshem sekak ukeshemmaggia hechag nimlak aleha lesikkuk, vehattora omra "taaseh" — velo min heasuy bipsul, vachabila zo shehunnecha sham shello leshem sekak apillu letzel ella kede leyabbeshah — en shem sekak aleha, venimtza sheasiyyatah shel sukka zo hi bipsul, lepikak gazeru chakamim shello yesakkekah bachabilot apillu hu metilah al hassukka leshem mitzvat sukkat hechag, gezera mishshum chabilot shel kol yemot hachamma:

Vekevan shello aseru ella mippene gezera zo, lo hutzreku leesor ella bachabila shedderek leyabbeshah, dehaynu sheyyesh bah lo pachot min esrim vachamishsha qanim, abal chabila sheen bah esrim vachamishsha qanim — muttar lesakkek bah:

Veim esrim vachamishsha qanim o yoter yotzein miggeza echad vehen meporadin beroshan hashsheni vaagadan sham, ap al pi ken kevan sheiqqaran echad — eno domeh lachabila shedderek leyabbeshah velaken muttar lesakkek bah. Veim agad immahen qaneh echad sheenah mechubberet immahen beiqqar echad, im yesh bachabila zo im qaneh zeh esrim vachamishsha qanim — niqret chabila, veen mesakkekin bah:

Qanim sheosin otan chabilot chabilot kede lemokran bashshuq beminyan ukesheqqoneh otan halloqeach mattir agadan miyyad — muttar lesakkek bahen, veen bahen mishshum gezerat chabila shel kol yemot hachamma, kevan shechabila zo en derek lehatzniah baagadah, vehalloqechah kede leyabbeshah mattir agadah miyyad:

Chabilot sheosin mearaba verashehen haggassim letzad echad verashehen haddaqqin letzad acher vedarkan leqoshran bishne rashehen, kevan shehittir qesher shebberosh haggas — muttar lesakkek bahen, mishshum shehaqqesher shellatztzad haacher eno chazaq kol kak sheyyitqayyem im yetaltel et hachabila, vekol eged sheeno asuy letaltelo baagado — eno niqra eged kelal:
Abal im qashar et hachabila beemtzaah bilbad — en mesakkekin bah, mippene shehi mittaltelet beeged zeh:

Im abar vesikkek bachabila — mattir agadah vehi keshera. Veap al pi shettechillat asiyyat sukka zo hayeta bipsul — en leposlah mishshum "taaseh velo min heasuy bipsul", kevan sheen pissulah ella mechamat gezera bealma kemo shennitbaer. Abal chabila sheheela otah leyabbeshah ukeshehiggia hechag nimlak aleha lesikkuk sheppesula min hattora, shehare lo hunnecha sham leshem tzel — en moil lah hattarat haeged lehakshirah, kevan sheppissulah lo haya mechamat haeged bilbad, ella hannachatah shello leshem tzel garam lah lehippasel min hattora, lepikak tzarik laasot maaseh chadash lehannachatah, dehaynu sheyyagbihennu meat veyachazor veyannichehu leshem tzel, vegam tzarik lehattir agadah, sheen mesakkekin bachabila gezera mishshum chabila shel kol yemot hachamma kemo shennitbaer:

Nesarim sherochban arbaa tepachim — asur lesakkek bahen, lepi sherob tiqrot habbayit asuyot mehen, veyesh lachosh shemma yesheb tachat tiqrat beto veyomar mah li lesakkek binsarim ellu, mah li lesheb tachat tiqrat beti, ap hi minnesarim asuya, vetiqrat habbayit hi pesula min hattora mittaam shennitbaer besiman trk"v:

Vaapillu im lo hetil rochab hannesarim al gabbe hassukka ella hapakan vehishkiban al tziddan shehu pachut mearbaa tepachim — ap al pi ken pesula, dekevan sheyyesh shem pesul alehen — naasu keshappudin shel matteket happesulin lesakkek bekol inyan shehopekan:

Abal muttar lesakkek binsarim sheen rochban arbaa tepachim, vaapillu im hem meshuppin vedomin lekelim, veap al pi shehen reuyim lishiba, [ve]gam hen reuyin lehishtammesh bahen lehanniach perot vekikkarot al gabbehen shehare hen rechabin qetzat — ap al pi ken enan meqabbelin tuma im enan meyuchadin lo lishiba velo leshum tashmish, ella omedin lebinyan o listira:

Veakshav bizman hazzeh shemmesakkekin habbattim binsarim sheen bahen shelosha tepachim — yesh lipsol sukka hamsukkeket apillu binsarim sheen berochban shelosha tepachim, mishshum gezera shemma yesheb tachat tiqrat beto haasuya minnesarim kaellu. Abal muttar lesakkek binsarim qetzarim meod sheqqorin (layty"sh o shyndly"n), sheen derek laasot tiqrat habbayit minnesarim qetzarim kaellu. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher laasot hassekak aray veqal, beinyan sheyyukelu haggeshamim lered betoko kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"a. Ulepikak nahagu haolam shello lesakkek bahen kelal, shemma yitu lesakkek beinyan qebiut shello yukelu haggeshamim lered betoko:
Ubishat haddechaq sheen lahem bemah lesakkek — mesakkekin binsarim apillu yesh bahem arbaa tepachim im i epshar beinyan acher. Vehu haddin bekol dabar haasur mishshum gezera: chaser
